facts.fact: NIDA's procedures of December 2023 state that cell executive secretaries enter community births and deaths into the national centralised civil registration system (NCI-CRVS), that sector civil registrars record, verify and digitally sign marriages and the other events in it, and that all civil registers have existed only in electronic form since 17 February 2023; registration points number 3,220 across health facilities and cell and sector offices, against 416 sector sites before 2020.
facts.system: administrative offices at cell and sector level working in the NCI-CRVS
